data.content_ref: inline:The target explicitly refuses the problem’s required task of adjudicating between rival protocols, declaring the comparison “founded on a false premise,” whereas the problem statement explicitly demands adjudication “wherever the evidence allows.” Additionally, it substitutes a causal mechanism with an abstract impossibility invocation and a Schrödinger metaphor, never specifying the concrete causal steps by which external witnesses record attestations or how a reclamation agent consults them without reintroducing the same crash-observability race.
